Monthly meeting

Sunday Tea & Stitch

1st or 2nd Sunday · 1 – 4 pm Open to all

A relaxed new Sunday-afternoon meeting, open to everyone — no guild membership required. Perfect if you work during the week or are new to stitching, so bring a friend. There’s no formal program: work on whatever you like, ask for help, and share what you’re making. Tea is served, so bring your favorite cup if you have one.

Sunday Tea & Stitch meets in Kris H’s community room at City Bella in Richfield — not at MVUUF. We would love to have you.

We’d love to have you. Come sit in on Sunday Tea & Stitch, or any of our other monthly meetings — in person or on Zoom, whichever fits your calendar. Try as many as you’re curious about. Once you’ve found the one (or three) that feel like yours, join us for just $30 a year.
